acts.label: Act One
acts.desc: Bob and Dave were close childhood friends — until their relationship began to lead their peers to believe that it might be more than a friendship. The accusations led to Dave turning on Bob.
acts.title: Dave's Love

acts.label: Act Two
acts.desc: The story of Dave and Bob continues. For reasons that Bob never fully understood, Dave successfully turned everyone in their school against his former friend, even forming clubs devoted to hating Bob.
acts.title: Dave's Hatred

acts.label: Act Three
acts.desc: Ira reaches current-day Dave, who is a born-again Christian living with his parents. According to Dave, Bob was at fault for the breakdown in their relationship, because Bob had decided to become friends with someone else. He remembers very little of the fight that is so vivid in Bob's memory.
acts.title: Dave's Response

acts.label: Act Four
acts.desc: Sarah Thyre reads author David Sedaris' "The Last Time You'll Ever Hear from Me," a story of the ultimate Machiavellian scheming.
acts.title: Another Dave
